nodes.name: Cada 5 minutos
nodes.notes: Antes corria cada hora: un recordatorio programado para una hora exacta salia en el siguiente tick, hasta 59 min tarde. Cada 5 min da precision razonable y no cuesta nada: todo lo que hace el ciclo es SQL, sin LLM.

parameters.query:
insert into public.reminders (kind, ref_table, ref_id, window_key, contact_id, scheduled_for)
select 'payment_due', 'payments', pm.id, w.key, p.contact_id,
       (pm.due_date + w.offset_days)::timestamp + time '09:30'
from public.payments pm
join public.policies p on p.id = pm.policy_id
join (values ('D-7',-7),('D-3',-3),('D-1',-1),('D0',0),('D+3',3),('D+7',7)) as w(key, offset_days) on true
join public.contacts c on c.id = p.contact_id
where pm.status in ('pending','overdue')
  and coalesce((c.metadata->>'do_not_disturb')::boolean, false) = false
  and (pm.due_date + w.offset_days) between current_date - 1 and current_date + 1
on conflict (kind, ref_id, window_key) do nothing
returning id;

nodes.name: Planificar recordatorios de pago
nodes.notes: Idempotente por el UNIQUE (kind, ref_id, window_key) en public.reminders — correr esta query N veces no crea duplicados (D001/§Cobranzas).

parameters.query:
insert into public.reminders (kind, ref_table, ref_id, window_key, contact_id, scheduled_for)
select 'policy_renewal', 'policies', pol.id, w.key, pol.contact_id,
       (pol.end_date + w.offset_days)::timestamp + time '09:30'
from public.policies pol
join (values ('D-30',-30),('D-15',-15),('D-5',-5)) as w(key, offset_days) on true
join public.contacts c on c.id = pol.contact_id
where pol.status = 'active'
  and coalesce((c.metadata->>'do_not_disturb')::boolean, false) = false
  and (pol.end_date + w.offset_days) between current_date - 1 and current_date + 1
on conflict (kind, ref_id, window_key) do nothing
returning id;

select r.id as reminder_id, r.kind, r.window_key, r.contact_id, r.ref_table, r.ref_id,
       c.phone, c.name
from public.reminders r
join public.contacts c on c.id = r.contact_id
where r.status = 'pending'
  and r.scheduled_for <= now()
  and extract(hour from now() at time zone coalesce((select value #>> '{}' from public.settings where key='timezone'), 'America/Caracas')) between
      (select (value #>> '{}')::int from public.settings where key='business_hours_start')
      and (select (value #>> '{}')::int from public.settings where key='business_hours_end')
  and (
    (select value #>> '{}' from public.settings where key='mode') = 'production'
    or c.phone in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(value) from public.settings where key='test_allowlist')
  )
order by r.scheduled_for asc
limit 50
for update of r skip locked;

nodes.name: Seleccionar pendientes a enviar
nodes.notes: Respeta ventana horaria 08-20 (public.settings) y TEST_MODE/allowlist (D009). FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED evita que dos ejecuciones concurrentes tomen el mismo recordatorio.

parameters.query:
select r.id as reminder_id, r.kind, r.window_key, r.message_text, c.phone, c.name as full_name,
       pm.amount, pm.due_date, pm.currency, pol.policy_number, ins.name as insurer_name,
       pol.end_date
from public.reminders r
join public.contacts c on c.id = r.contact_id
left join public.payments pm on r.ref_table = 'payments' and pm.id = r.ref_id
left join public.policies polp on pm.policy_id = polp.id
left join public.policies pol on r.ref_table = 'policies' and pol.id = r.ref_id
left join public.insurers ins on ins.id = coalesce(polp.insurer_id, pol.insurer_id)
where r.id = $1;

nodes.name: Construir texto (sin LLM)
nodes.notes: Determinista desde SQL — nunca un LLM calcula o redacta un monto adeudado (principio rector).

nodes.name: Enviar WhatsApp (Evolution)
nodes.notes: Migrado de WaAPI a Evolution API v2 el 2026-08-23 (R014). Endpoint /message/sendText/{instancia}, body {number, text} — el número va en dígitos, sin @c.us. Credencial 'Evolution API saliente' (header apikey). JSON.stringify evita romper el body con comillas o saltos de línea.

parameters.query: update public.reminders set status = 'sent', sent_at = now() where id = $1;
update public.reminders set status = 'failed', error = $2 where id = $1;
